title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad
content:
2024-11-02 - daily scratchpad

Top priorities:
- Finish collecting evidence for CC6.1 (user access reviews) — need monthly access review exports from Okta and AD.
- Vendor AOC status: AuthN provider (Auth0) — follow up on AOC & penetration test report.
- Cloud audit logs: CloudTrail/Stackdriver export for 2024-10 (bind to evidence bucket).

Quick TODOs:
- [ ] Request Okta monthly export (CSV) from Alex (INF-301). Ticket created: JIRA/INF-301 (waiting).
- [ ] Pull MFA enforcement report (Auth0) — Priya to check whether we have screenshots + policy text.
- [x] Draft mapping for CC7.2 (encryption) -> added KMS key rotation schedule note.
- [ ] Upload access-logs evidence to evidence-bucket: evidence/access-logs-2024-10.zip
- [ ] Confirm retention policy doc update is in Confluence (confluence/SOC2-EVIDENCE-INDEX -> data-retention-policy-draft).

Evidence file naming conventions (for consistency):
- evidence/<control>-<artifact>-YYYY-MM-DD.zip or .pdf (e.g., evidence/cc6-user-review-2024-10-31.pdf)
- evidence/vendor-auth0-aoc-2024-10.pdf

Notes / context:
- Vendor review: Auth0 AOC expected — Samira flagged missing AOC in last review. Action: Priya to email vendor (cc Samira) for AOC + recent pentest summary.
- Cloud logs: need 90-day retention sample to show continuous logging. Confirm CloudTrail delivery to S3 for 2024-10. If not present, escalate to Alex.
- KMS: rotation schedule exists (kms-rotation-schedule-2024-09.pdf). Need evidence that rotation occurred (rotation event logs).
- DB backups: snapshot schedule -> attach snapshot manifest (evidence/db-backups-manifest-2024-10.csv).

People to ping:
- Priya Desai - SOC2 PM (status updates, vendor follow-ups)
- Alex Gomez - infra (CloudTrail exports, S3 permissions)
- Samira Khan - evidence reviewer (control mappings, AOC checks)
- Legal (for vendor contracts) - check contract dates + AOC clauses

Meeting notes / reminders:
- 11/03 10:30 sync w/ Priya — walk through outstanding vendor AOCs and missing evidence list.
- Weekly compliance sync Fridays 09:00 — bring updated evidence index.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we have formal signed AOC for Auth0 or just attestation email? (need scanned copy)
- Which S3 bucket should contain final evidence archive (evidence-prod vs evidence-scratch)? Use evidence-prod for final 
- Are there outstanding GCP logs from the month of Oct missing from the evidence bucket? Check with Alex.

Quick draft text for email to Auth0 (Priya / Samira to review):
"Hi [Auth0 contact],

We're preparing SOC2 evidence and need your most recent AOC and penetration testing summary for our records. Could you please provide the signed AOC and any test reports for 2023/2024? Ideally a PDF we can archive.

Thanks,
Jordan (on behalf of Redwood SOC2 team)"

Local checklist to clear before next review:
- [ ] All 10/2024 logs uploaded to evidence bucket and named correctly.
- [ ] Vendor AOC files (Auth0, SSO) saved and linked in evidence index.
- [ ] Policy docs updated in Confluence (data retention, backup & restore, vendor management) with last-modified stamp.
- [ ] Control mapping sheet updated -> link to confluence/SOC2-CONTROL-MAP (WIP).

Small notes to self:
- Use the "evidence-template-v2" when zipping artifacts (strip PII, include readme.txt).
- Remember to redact ticket descriptions that contain user PII before uploading.
- Keep a running index CSV: evidence-index-2024-11.csv (columns: control,jira,evidence-file,owner,date).

End of scratchpad.
